network.scope: Only skills with an entry in security/network_policy.json may reach the network; hosts, HTTPS, timeout, and expiry are per-entry.
network.enforced_by: npm run generate:manifests (blocks on missing or expired entry)

file_write.scope: Source edits and artifact writes declared per skill in its generated manifest.yaml permissions block.
file_write.reason: Write permission mirrors the skill contract surface; the risk level (low/medium/high/critical) in the same manifest gates how writes are used.

shell.scope: Project-local validation, git operations, and container commands declared per skill in its generated manifest.yaml.
shell.reason: Destructive or remote shell operations are additionally covered by eng-destructive-safety-gate and the user-authorization gates inside governed lifecycles.

governed_release_blocks: critical-risk skill without a current review (review_due past)
network-capable skill without a current security/network_policy.json approval
